title: SerreSectionModuleConstruction
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x_0,x_1] with its total-degree grading, and P=Proj S as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. For every O_P-module G, there is an S-module M internally graded by additive subgroups M_z (z in Z), vanishing for z<0, with additive isomorphisms M_z to Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(z)) for z>=0, intertwining multiplication by every homogeneous polynomial a in S_e with G tensor twistMul(z,a). Here O_P(z) and twistMul are the twisting sheaves and multiplication maps of [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. No coherence or finite generation is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Form the additive direct sum of Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(n)) for n>=0. Define homogeneous scalar multiplication by the global-sections map induced by G tensor twistMul(n,a), and extend to all polynomials by homogeneous decomposition. The formula for twistMul in local fractions proves additivity, identity, and product compatibility, hence the module laws. Each summand image gives M_n; put M_z=0 in negative degrees. The summand identifications give the internal grading, phi and the compatibility.

lean.statement: theorem serreSectionModuleConstruction (k : Type u) [Field k] (G : (Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules) : ∃ (M : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)), ∃ (𝓜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup M), DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜 ∧ (∀ (e : ℕ) (z : ℤ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (y : M), a ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k e → y ∈ 𝓜 z → a • y ∈ 𝓜 (e + z)) ∧ (∀ z : ℤ, z < 0 → 𝓜 z = ⊥) ∧ ∃ (φ : ∀ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z → (𝓜 z ≃+ Γ(G ⊗ Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) z, ⊤))), ∀ (z : ℤ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (e : ℕ) (hze : 0 ≤ z + e) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (ha : a ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k e) (y : 𝓜 z) (hay : a • (y : M) ∈ 𝓜 (z + e)), φ (z + e) hze ⟨a • (y : M), hay⟩ = Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (G ◁ Proj.twistMul z ha) ⊤ (φ z hz y)
